dosing.anxiety: 1-2 mg/day in divided doses (1 mg twice daily typical); elderly 0.5-1 mg/day

withdrawal: taper gradually: reduce by 25% every 1-2 weeks (or slower in long-term users 10-25% every 2-4 weeks); switch to equivalent diazepam for smoother taper; total taper can take 6-12 weeks or longer in long-term use
